subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped upgrade of fourteen pinned GitHub Action revisions, including the Codex action used at API-key and repository-write boundaries?
rationale: The patch is a standard Dependabot revision update and no line-level defect was found, but accepting new executable CI action revisions at secret-bearing workflows is a repository trust decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Approve the reviewed pins
options.body: Accept the grouped revisions after the workflow-security owner confirms the upstream action revisions are approved for the existing token and API-key boundaries.

options.title: Split the sensitive action updates
options.body: Keep ordinary setup and utility action upgrades separate while reviewing `openai/codex-action`, GitHub App token, Docker publish, and attestation revisions in narrower PRs.

options.title: Pause the dependency group
options.body: Close or defer this automated update if the repository does not currently want to advance these workflow action revisions together.

recommendation.title: Approve the reviewed pins
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped revisions after the workflow-security owner confirms the upstream action revisions are approved for the existing token and API-key boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline subscription is the strongest available signal for ownership of this workflow-security decision.
